text:
You need a reliable way to generate lots of hour-long house sets from AI-generated tracks, filter the good ones, and layer in provided lyrics without turning the process into a time sink.

Hi Danny — I’m Noor Halden, and I’d love to help with this. I have 6 years of experience working with Python and machine learning, including PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, and pandas. While my background is in ML and AI workflows rather than being a full-time DJ by trade, I’m very comfortable building systems that help sort, structure, and automate creative output — which feels directly relevant to this role.

A couple of projects that show the kind of work I do:

- Delivery support chatbot: I built a WhatsApp and SMS assistant for Parcelwise Logistics that tracks parcels, reschedules deliveries, and hands off to a human with full context. It resolved 43% of conversations without an agent and reached a CSAT of 4.4 out of 5.
- Coffee review themes: I built a small Streamlit app for Cobalt Coffee Roasters that grouped 38k marketplace reviews into themes and tracked sentiment per theme each week. It found 12 stable themes and replaced about 2 days a month of manual tagging.

For this project, I’d approach the workflow as a curation and assembly problem: generate lots of candidate tracks, score or organize them, keep the strongest material, and then assemble the final set in a structured way. I’m also comfortable using AI tools to accelerate repetitive parts of the process, including content handling and organization around lyrics and set-building.

On the music side, I’m excited by house and electronic music and by the idea of using AI to expand what’s possible creatively. I’d be glad to work within your preferred tools and production process, and I can adapt to the software you’re already using for making or mixing.

I’m available full-time.

What software or workflow are you currently using for track generation, selection, and mixing so I can fit into it cleanly?
